policy: A new complete grammatical system has complete coherent practice. New lexemes of already taught patterns receive full literal evidence tables and purposeful contextual practice. Reference-only number and syntax positions are visible without fabricated productive uses. Any unpracticed productive form remains explicit for coordinator review.

This lexical system transfers an already taught inflectional pattern; its contextual tasks below practice the lexical choice and ordinary use. The table alone is not counted as assessment. The companion strong/weak table uses the same lexical stem diagnostics; related lexical practice below is evidence of that transfer, not a claim that every companion-table cell was independently produced.
systems.scope: Complete24 NGDA singular/plural positions. Positive degree only; strong/weak choice follows prior teaching. New senses are separately explicit.
